commands.cmd:
d="$(mktemp -d)" && chmod 700 "$d" && export RESTIC_REPOSITORY="$d/repo" RESTIC_PASSWORD="$(python3 -c 'import secrets;print(secrets.token_hex(16))')" RESTIC_CACHE_DIR="$d/cache" && restic init -q && restic backup -q --json adoption > "$d/backup.json"; b=$?; restic check -q --read-data > "$d/check.log" 2>&1; c=$?; restic restore -q latest --target "$d/restore" --verify > "$d/restore.log" 2>&1; r=$?; python3 - "$d" "$b" "$c" "$r" <<'PY'
import json, sys, pathlib, filecmp
d = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); b, c, r = (int(x) for x in sys.argv[2:5])
s = [json.loads(l) for l in (d / 'backup.json').read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
s = [x for x in s if x.get('message_type') == 'summary'][0]
src = pathlib.Path('adoption')
rest = next(p for p in (d / 'restore').rglob('adoption') if p.is_dir())
files = [p.relative_to(src) for p in src.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
same = all(filecmp.cmp(src / f, rest / f, shallow=False) for f in files)
extra = sorted(str(p.relative_to(rest)) for p in rest.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.relative_to(rest) not in set(files))
print('backup exit', b, 'files_new', s['files_new'], 'bytes', s['total_bytes_processed'], 'snapshot', s['snapshot_id'][:8], '| check --read-data exit', c, '| restore --verify exit', r, '| byte-identical', len(files), 'files', same, '| extra', extra)
raise SystemExit(0 if (b, c, r) == (0, 0, 0) and same and not extra and s['files_new'] == len(files) else 1)
PY
ok=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $ok
